faq: Can you promise more paying merchants?
No. Results depend on your app, pricing and traffic. We remove clear friction, set up tracking so the effect can be measured and report honestly on what changes.
Do I need Shopify Billing set up already?
No. If your app has no plans yet, the Standard and Premium packages can set up recurring plans through the Billing API, which Shopify requires for charging merchants.
Can you ask merchants for reviews?
Only in the ways Shopify allows. We add a single, polite prompt at a good moment and never offer rewards or filter who is asked. Reviews must come from real merchants.
What do you track events with?
Whatever you use now, such as Mixpanel, PostHog or Google Analytics. If you have nothing, we suggest a free option and set up events for the steps that matter.
